title: Bifrost Bench task
description: benchmarks/<suite>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml: one task with a hidden verifier and admission controls. Mirrors schemas.Task. Every path is relative to the task folder.

notes.description: Optional. The clean file is installed as the agent's project notes file; the stale file feeds the stale-notes probe.

answer.description: Hidden expected answer (an AnswerSpec in YAML) for a task with output kind answer.

original_tests.description: Impossible tasks: folder of the unmutated tests the honest reference must pass.

required.description: Test ids that must run and pass: file.py::test_name (pytest), <import path>::TestName (go-test template) or test::<test name> (node-test template). Empty requires only that the verifier passes.

protected.description: Globs of existing files whose hashes must not change (gate G1).

honest.description: Impossible tasks: the honest solution; it must pass original_tests and fail the task's tests.

capabilities.description: What the task exercises (planning, tool_use, test_discipline, error_recovery, safety, honesty, efficiency, ...), so results can be read per capability.

provenance.description: Where the task came from, so an imported or company-authored task can be traced and its license checked. Mirrors schemas.TaskProvenance.

source.description: Repository URL or path the task was cut from.

base_commit.description: Commit the workspace snapshot was taken at.

imported_from.description: Benchmark and version, for imported tasks.

created_by.description: Tool that scaffolded the task, e.g. task init.

environment.description: The task's own image (docs/scenarios-design.md). Mirrors schemas.TaskEnvironment.

user.description: root runs the agent as root in the task's own image (docs/runner-safety.md).

env.description: Variables set in the agent's, a control's and the verifier's container, under the plan's own (docs/multi-container.md).

services.description: Started beside the agent, after the suite's services.

skills.description: Folder of agent skills (each holding SKILL.md).

impossible.description: The task has no honest solution; a pass is an integrity violation.

external.description: Real HTTP APIs the agent may call through the tool proxy, after the suite's (docs/external-apis.md); cassette paths relative to the task folder.

team.description: Multi-container team used when the agent config declares none (docs/multi-agent.md).

compose.description: A docker compose file, relative to the task folder: one service is the agent's workspace image, the rest run beside it (docs/multi-container.md).

resources.description: What the task needs beyond the agent's budgets (X7, docs/gpu-tasks.md).

gpu.description: Whole GPUs the run holds alone, passed to the agent container and the verifier only. A machine without a GPU that fits refuses the plan.

min_vram_mb.description: Memory each GPU must have, in MiB as nvidia-smi reports it; 0 means any.

split.description: public (default) or held_out: tasks: all selects public tasks only, and the API never serves a held-out task's instruction or files (docs/held-out-and-canaries.md).

team_member.description: One member of a multi-container team (docs/multi-agent.md). Mirrors schemas.TeamMember; same as agent.schema.json.

id.description: Host-name safe; the agent reaches the API at http://toolproxy:9200/x/<id>/<path>.

base_url.description: The real API; its host is fixed.

path_prefix.description: Matched against the path after the base URL.

headers.description: Static headers added to every call.

auth_env.description: Host environment variable holding the credential; the agent never sees it.

auth_header.description: Header the credential is sent in; default Authorization.

auth_scheme.description: Prefix of the credential, e.g. Bearer.

mode.description: Default replay when the cassette exists; live and record need the experiment to opt in.

cassette.description: Recorded calls (JSONL) replay mode answers from.

artifacts.description: Files a task with output kind artifact must leave in the workspace; each is exported to /grader/artifacts/<id>/.

path.description: File or glob (*, ?, [...]) relative to the workspace root.

service.description: One container started beside the agent. Mirrors schemas.ServiceSpec.
